# manxttc (Manx TT Superbike, Twin, Revision C; Model 2A-CRX): entry points the
# recompiler cannot find by itself. The MAME harvest (scripts/run_trace.sh's
# branches.txt: the targets of indirect branches, calls and balx, the interrupt
# handlers and the IAC target) over attract, a scripted race and a test-mode
# walk; the interrupted addresses are not seeds. Addresses only (our own
# analysis; rules.md rule 7).
